name: Robot-DIFT CoRL 2026 paper protocol (Stage I, DROID)

source.title: Robot-DIFT: Correspondence-Sensitive Diffusion Features for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation

scope: Stage-I settings stated in the paper, checked against the configuration that train_droid_auto.py resolves for scripts/release/stage1_paper_protocol.sh. A match does not establish checkpoint provenance or downstream results.

linear_lr_end_factor.note: The paper says linear but not its endpoint.

ema_inverse_gamma_and_cap.note: Matches the Stage-II preset; the paper states only power 0.75.

vae_posterior.note: Posterior mean keeps the deployed Student deterministic.

clip_text_encoder.note: The paper does not name the CLIP variant; Stage I and Stage II share it.

readout_dimensions.value: fpn 256, model 256, 8 heads, 1 Transformer layer, MLP 1024-512, output 512

student_freeze_steps.note: Optional head-first phase (Student fixed while the readout and policy train); off in the release protocol.

student_lr_warmup_steps.note: Optional linear Student LR warmup; off in the release protocol.

rgb_only_policy.note: No proprioception input, so the Student must carry the control signal.

weight_decay.note: Not specified in the paper; this implementation uses zero.

student_weight_decay.note: Not specified in the paper; this implementation uses zero.

readout_weight_decay.note: Not specified in the paper; this implementation uses zero.

learning_rate_warmup.note: Not specified in the paper; this implementation uses zero.

original_stage1_batch_allocation.value: 8 GPUs x batch 32 per GPU x accumulation 1 = 256
original_stage1_batch_allocation.source: Author-confirmed training configuration; no gradient accumulation.

limitations: The checks compare the resolved training configuration, not a completed run or checkpoint.
The S2-FPN/readout operator details the paper leaves open are fixed by agents/encoders/robot_dift_paper_readout.py.

Section 2.2 describes Student+S2-FPN as a frozen deployment backbone while Appendix S5.1 says Stage II trains the S2-FPN/readout; Stage II here initializes the readout fusion from Stage I and trains it per task.
